cases.purpose: On a noncanonical PTY, a 2-byte and a 4-byte scalar each delivered in two writes 200 ms apart are returned as one complete scalar each.
cases.script: bashtermraw raw; wget_wch read > a; wget_wch read > b; bashtermraw cooked
cases.oracle: wget_wch help text: read [FD] decodes one UTF-8 scalar/cluster and prints 'wch U+XXXX[,U+YYYY...] bytes=N'; nonseekable lookahead is process-local; extension marks join only when immediately available (wget_wch.c bww_read_cluster uses a poll(0) check); invalid or incomplete input fails (rc 1, no record). Code points per Unicode/UTF-8 (RFC 3629).

cases.purpose: A combining acute (U+0301) written 300 ms after its base 'e' is not joined: the base is returned alone and the mark is the next record; the same pair in one write is joined into one cluster.
cases.script: bashtermraw raw; wget_wch read > base; wget_wch read > mark; wget_wch read > joined; bashtermraw cooked

cases.purpose: Complete scalars typed on a canonical-mode terminal (line delivered on Enter) decode the same as the same bytes from a pipe: e-acute, CJK U+4E2D, then the newline.
cases.script:
for i in 1 2 3; do wget_wch read; done > tty-records
printf '\303\251\344\270\255\n' | { for i in 1 2 3; do wget_wch read; done; } > pipe-records
[[ $(< tty-records) == "$(< pipe-records)" ]] && echo same > compare || echo differ > compare

Code points per Unicode/UTF-8 (RFC 3629).
cases.comparison: contract: decoded record lines from the canonical PTY and from a pipe, plus their equality

expected_files.tty-records:
wch U+00E9 bytes=2
wch U+4E2D bytes=3
wch U+000A bytes=1
expected_files.pipe-records:
wch U+00E9 bytes=2
wch U+4E2D bytes=3
wch U+000A bytes=1

cases.purpose: On a canonical PTY, a UTF-8 lead byte followed by ^D (end of input after the partial line; the 1-byte continuation read then sees EOF, and a second ^D is sent in case the first only delivers the partial line) fails with rc 1 and no record; the shell continues.
cases.script: wget_wch read > rec; printf '%s\n' "$?" > rc; printf 'after\n' > after
